subject.title: Feishu: replied/quoted message mentions show as raw @_user_N placeholders

question: Should maintainers adopt/narrow the open fork PR at https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/930, or clear it and allow a fresh narrow Feishu-only repair for this issue?
rationale: The source-level defect is clear, but a live open fork PR still uses closing syntax for this issue while carrying the same broad conflicting 18-file branch that was closed unmerged in the target repo.

options.title: Clear fork and queue narrow repair
options.body: Close or mark the conflicting fork path non-viable, then allow one focused Feishu parser/test repair for fetched-message mentions.

options.title: Adopt only the Feishu slice
options.body: Use the fork PR only as source context, discard unrelated changes, and review a narrowed branch that touches the Feishu fetched-message parser and tests.

options.title: Leave owner-driven
options.body: Keep the issue open for the Feishu plugin owner to implement with live workspace proof when ready.

recommendation.title: Clear fork and queue narrow repair
recommendation.body: Close or mark the conflicting fork path non-viable, then allow one focused Feishu parser/test repair for fetched-message mentions.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is confined to the declared Feishu/Lark plugin boundary and the linked branch adoption question.
